- Démontrer un intérêt pour le développement infonuagique et les plateformes telles qu'Amazon Web Services (AWS).

- Expérience en développement front-end ou full-stack (Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS), un atout.
- Intérêt pour l'IA/ML, l'automatisation et les services backend intelligents.

- Interest in cloud-based software development and deployment technologies such as Amazon Web Services.

- Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to ask questions, receive feedback, and grow as a software engineer.

- Experience with Java backend development, including frameworks or tools commonly used for web services. 
- Exposure to automated testing frameworks and practices for unit, component, functional, or integration testing. 
- Familiarity with DevOps concepts such as CI/CD, source control, build pipelines, deployment, observability, or cloud infrastructure. 
- Exposure to frontend or full-stack development is a plus, especially with Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, or CSS.

Il ou elle collaborera avec les différentes équipes afin d’obtenir l’information, de centraliser et de simplifier l’accès aux données. Ce stage offre une occasion concrète d’acquérir de l’expérience en durabilité des emballages et en gestion de données.

Le programme de stages se déroulera du 10 mai au 13 août 2027.

Basé à notre bureau de Saint-Léonard, Montréal.

CHEZ SAPUTO, VOUS POURREZ…



- Écrire l’avenir de l’industrie – Nous sommes un chef de file mondial de la transformation laitière parce que nous abordons les défis avec passion et optimisme. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d’une équipe engagée qui cherche constamment des solutions meilleures et plus efficaces pour façonner l’avenir de notre industrie.
- Avoir un impact dès le premier jour – L’action concrète fait partie de notre culture. Dès votre première journée, vous contribuerez à notre réussite, car nous misons sur les talents de chaque membre de notre personnel.

COMMENT VOUS APPORTEREZ UNE CONTRIBUTION SIGNIFICATIVE…



- Collecter et répertorier dans une base de données l’ensemble des spécifications techniques (primaires, secondaires et tertiaires) des emballages, y compris les poids et les compositions; mettre à jour et valider ces informations auprès des usines ou des fournisseurs lorsqu’elles ne sont pas disponibles.
- Soutenir la collecte de données et la production du rapport annuel du Registre fédéral des plastiques.
- Analyser les tarifs de la REP (responsabilité élargie des producteurs) afin de cerner les écarts et les occasions de réduction des coûts, et s’assurer que la classification des emballages est adéquate en fonction de leurs spécifications.

CE RÔLE VOUS CONVIENT SI VOUS…

Êtes en troisième ou en quatrième année d'un baccalauréat en génie (chimique, industriel, mécanique ou de l’environnement) ou en sciences de l’environnement ou en développement durable.

- Possédez de bonnes habiletés de communication et de collaboration avec des équipes multifonctionnelles et des fournisseurs.
- Avez un intérêt pour les emballages, les matériaux et la durabilité (une connaissance de la réglementation est un atout).
- Êtes bilingue (français et anglais).

Job Description

Please note that this is a hybrid role requiring 3 days in the office.

Great software starts with people who are curious enough to question how things work and bold enough to build something better. At Sage, you won’t spend your internship watching from the sidelines. You’ll contribute to real engineering work from day one.

At Sage, we create technology that helps businesses work more effectively and make better decisions. With colleagues and customers around the world, you’ll see how ideas become products and services with real impact.

Why join Sage?

This is not an internship built around observation or hypothetical exercises. You’ll join a live engineering team and work on technology connected to Sage, our products or our customers.

You’ll learn from experienced engineers, use modern development practices and see how software is designed, tested and delivered in a global technology business. You’ll have support from your manager, technical mentor and buddy, alongside structured learning and an intern community.

Key Responsibilities

We’re looking for curious, motivated people who enjoy solving problems and want to turn ideas into working technology. You’ll contribute to team priorities while building your confidence as an engineer.

You will:



-  Design, develop and test software with support from experienced engineers
-  Break problems into manageable steps and compare different technical approaches
-  Write clear, maintainable code and respond constructively to review feedback
-  Use source control, testing and other engineering tools as part of day-to-day delivery
-  Investigate defects and use evidence to identify likely causes
-  Consider security, privacy, reliability, accessibility and performance when building solutions
-  Use approved AI tools thoughtfully, checking outputs with your own technical judgement
-  Share progress clearly and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other interns

Your Real-World Engineering Project

A key part of the internship will be a defined engineering project with a clear problem, audience and outcome. Depending on your team, this could involve building or improving software, exploring an AI-supported solution, working with data, testing AI outputs or developing a proof of concept.



-  Agree the scope and success measures
-  Explore different approaches before deciding what to build
-  Design, develop and test your solution
-  Use AI and engineering tools responsibly
-  Gather feedback through regular check-ins and a midpoint review
-  Present a working demonstration and explain your decisions
-  Reflect on what worked, what you would change and what you learned

What we are looking for

People who thrive here are curious, practical and willing to keep learning. We care more about your potential and thinking than the number of technologies you already know.

You may be studying Computer Science, Software Engineering or another relevant technical subject.

You will bring:



-  An interest in building technology and understanding how it works
-  Fundamentals in at least one programming language
-  A structured approach to solving problems
-  The confidence to ask questions and try different approaches
-  Clear communication and the ability to explain your thinking
-  A collaborative approach and willingness to contribute to a team
-  Learning agility and openness to feedback
-  An interest in how AI is changing software development, balanced with human judgement

You do not need professional software engineering experience. University work, personal projects, hackathons, societies, work experience and experimenting with technology all count.

What you will gain



-  Hands-on experience with real engineering work
-  A completed project you can explain and demonstrate
-  Structured technical learning and regular feedback
-  Support from a manager, technical mentor and buddy
-  Experience of modern engineering practices and responsible AI use
-  Exposure to Sage leaders and colleagues across the business
-  A cohort of interns learning alongside you
-  Potential consideration for an approved 2028 graduate role, subject to performance, business need and eligibility

What you can expect from the process



-  Apply online with your resume
-  Complete the online assessments.
-  If successful, attend an assessment center or local selection event
-  Successful candidates will join our Summer 2027 internship program

Here at Sage, we are committed to inclusivity for all. If there are any adjustments that would help you thrive in the application process or during your internship, please contact earlycareersadjustments@sage.com For all other queries, please contact earlycareers@sage.com

Kira is building the AI-native platform for education. We’re rethinking how teaching works by pairing educators with AI systems that can generate content, evaluate student work, and provide personalized feedback at scale. Our products are used by schools, districts, and universities. We’re an early-stage company with real customers, real usage, and a small, high-ownership team.



We’re looking for exceptional fullstack engineering interns to join us for Winter 2027. You’ll work on production systems used by students and teachers, not isolated intern projects. Over 12 weeks, you’ll own and ship a meaningful piece of the product, from initial design through deployment. This role is best suited for candidates who already build things independently and want to operate at a high bar.



What You’ll Work On



Intern projects typically sit directly on critical product paths, such as:

 - AI-powered grading and feedback systems

 - Student and teacher-facing product surfaces (dashboards, workflows)

 - Internal tools used by curriculum and operations teams

 - Infrastructure supporting LLM-based features (evals, prompt iteration, reliability)

You’ll work across the stack:

 - Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js

 - Backend: Node, Python

 - Data: APIs, databases, system integrations



What You’ll Do

 - Own a scoped project with a clear user outcome and ship it end-to-end

 - Write production-quality code that is reviewed, tested, and deployed

 - Participate in design discussions and code reviews with the team

 - Work directly with product and design to clarify requirements and tradeoffs

 - Debug real issues and improve system reliability and performance

 - Contribute to AI-powered features where relevant to your project
   

What We’re Looking For

 - Candidates who already operate at a high level of independence and technical maturity

 - Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Computer Science or a related field

 - Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and systems

 - Experience building and shipping non-trivial projects end-to-end

 - Comfortable working across the stack (not just frontend or backend in isolation)

 - Clear, structured thinking and strong written communication

 - Experience building fullstack applications or APIs from scratch

 - Exposure to LLMs or interest in building AI-powered systems

 - Evidence of initiative (open source, research, side projects, technical writing)
   

What You’ll Get

 - Ownership: You will ship meaningful product work used by real users

 - Mentorship in a high-signal environment -- small team, high standards, fast iteration

 - Exposure to product, design, and how real systems evolve

 - Return offer consideration for top-performing interns



Logistics

 - Start date: Jan 2027 (flexible ±2 weeks)

 - Duration: 12 weeks, part-time

 - Location: San Francisco (in-person 2 days per wk﻿)

 - Compensation: Competitive (discussed during process)

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. for the duration of the internship

Building on our nearly 40-year history of era-defining technology breakthroughs, we deliver leading-edge AI, high performance, lower-power computing, and unrivaled connectivity. We’re proud to be the partner of choice to many of the world’s largest enterprises. Together with our ecosystem partners, we enable next-generation digital transformation. At Qualcomm, we are engineering human progress. 

Join Us in Shaping the Future

At Qualcomm, we're committed to engineering human progress by delivering intelligent computing everywhere. We're passionate about harnessing the power of technology to transform industries and improve lives. Our early career programs offer limitless opportunities for growth, mentorship, and meaningful work. By joining our team, you'll be part of a community that's pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI, computing, and connectivity. With a global footprint spanning over 30 countries, you'll have the chance to collaborate with diverse talent and contribute to projects that are shaping the future of technology. 

Our early career programs are designed to attract inventive minds, offering a platform to contribute to our long-term innovation pipeline. You'll be part of a community that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Our programs provide real-world experience, technical skills, and professional development opportunities, empowering you to make a meaningful impact and achieve your career goals. Join us for our 2027 intern class in Markham, Canada! 

Maximize Your Opportunities: 
Our internship hiring model routes candidates from this application into multiple project specific roles. Your "Profile Visibility" choice will guide how we manage your data across our systems. To be considered for the full breadth of internship opportunities, select the option to use your profile data for "Any Roles Globally". 

If you choose to limit your data to "Only The Role I'm Applying For", it will restrict the opportunity for you to be considered across matching internship opportunities.

Steps:

 * Log Into Your Eightfold Candidate Home Account 
 * Hover Over The "Profile" Dropdown 
 * Open Settings

Role Overview

Qualcomm’s Adreno GPU has been the industry leading mobile graphics solution in today’s Android smart phone market worldwide.
